stories.title: 一次让我思考的参观
paragraphs: Last year, I visited a town museum with a friend. We stood by a massive map and read a paragraph about the occupation of the town. An army had come to occupy the town. A massacre had taken place there.
I asked why such things occur. My friend said this sad occurrence showed why peace matters. We spoke quietly because we did not want to offend other visitors.
I still remember one quote: 'Learn from the past.' I like museums that help me understand people.
stories.gist: 我和朋友参观小镇博物馆，了解当地的战争往事。一句“从过去学习”的话，让我记住了这次参观。

grammar.label: 定语从句 · 描述你喜欢的事物
grammar.example: I like museums that help me understand people.
grammar.explanation: that help me understand people 修饰 museums。

stories.retell: 博物馆 → 历史 → 引语
stories.rewrite: I like museums that help me _____.

stories.title: 周日一起改善公园
stories.en_title: A Small Change to Our Park
paragraphs: Mia: "Our town has a new scheme for the park. Can you spare an hour on Sunday?"
Ben: "Sure. I can offer some help. Which part of the park needs work?"
Mia: "This area is partly in the sun. We could plant trees where birds can raise their offspring."
Ben: "We only have a partial plan. How will we pay for the trees?"
Mia: "Selling old books could offset the cost. Even a marginal change would help."
Ben: "Good idea. If you need a partner, I'll join you."
stories.gist: 两人商量周日帮忙改善公园：种树给鸟儿一个家，再卖旧书补贴费用。计划还不完整，可以一起完善。

grammar.label: 真实条件句 · 提出帮助
grammar.example: If you need a partner, I'll join you.
grammar.explanation: If 从句用一般现在时，主句用 will + 动词原形。

stories.retell: 周日 → 公园 → 卖旧书
stories.rewrite: If you need a partner, I'll _____.

stories.title: 敢于尝试的一堂课
paragraphs: I wanted to participate in a science class, but I was afraid of making mistakes. "Don't let fear paralyse you," the teacher said.
Every participant worked in a small group. We built a small bridge with two parallel sticks. Then we found the mass of a stone and put it on the bridge. I saw a particle of sand fall from the stone.
I liked this particular class because I could learn by doing. When something went wrong, we tried again.
stories.gist: 我怕做错，老师鼓励我动手尝试。小组用木棍搭桥，再放上石头测试；做错了就再试一次。

grammar.label: 原因状语从句 · 解释你为什么喜欢
grammar.example: I liked this particular class because I could learn by doing.
grammar.explanation: because 引出原因，适合讲述经历和表达喜好。

stories.retell: 害怕 → 搭桥 → 再试一次
stories.rewrite: I liked this particular _____ because I could _____.

stories.title: 给喜欢的音乐留时间
paragraphs: Leo: "Are you going to quit the music club?"
Amy: "I have a passion for music, but my schedule is full."
Leo: "Could you make a quick change and keep Friday evening free?"
Amy: "The club asked us to fill in a questionnaire. I won't stay passive. I'll share my ideas."
Leo: "Even a short span of time can help."
Amy: "If I had more free time, I would play music with friends. My quest for a better week starts here."
stories.gist: 艾米热爱音乐，却觉得日程太满。她准备在俱乐部问卷中主动提建议，从小改变开始给爱好留时间。

grammar.label: 虚拟语气 · 谈谈你希望怎样改变
grammar.example: If I had more free time, I would play music with friends.
grammar.explanation: If + 过去式，主句用 would + 动词原形，假设当前情况。

stories.retell: 音乐 → 日程 → 小改变
